display.name: Chat latency & metal wake
display.description: Time to first token for chat turns, how the runtime behind each turn was woken and where that time went, and the two-tier idle-suspend policy that decides how often a wake is needed.

display.name: Chat time to first token (p50 / p95) by route
display.description: Request arrival at the API → first rendered frame (text, reasoning, tool call or error) from the runtime. The `start` frame and SSE keepalives don't count. Source: chat.ttft_ms.

display.name: Chat TTFT p95 by how the runtime was woken
display.description: wake.mode: cached (URL cache) / reused (already running) / resumed (snapshot) / assigned (cold boot) / joined (rode another request's wake) / none (non-metal). A wide gap between resumed and assigned is the cold-boot tax.

display.name: Chat TTFT breakdown p95 (resolve / headers / gateway / model)
display.description: resolve = runtime lookup + wake; upstream_headers = runtime accepting the turn; gateway_wait = runtime-reported wait for the agent gateway to start (x-shogo-gateway-wait-ms); model = headers → first token.

display.name: Chat TTFT p95, cold paths only
display.description: Only turns whose runtime had to resume or cold-boot. This is what 'slow after a long time away' looks like.

display.name: Wake end-to-end p95 by mode (API /assign wall time)
display.description: metal.wake_total_ms: lease + placement + env + budget + host /assign. Excludes URL-cache hits.

display.name: Wake phases p95 (resumed + cold boots)
display.description: api.* run in the API, host.* on the metal host (heavy_wait = queued behind the host's heavy semaphore; store_pull / restore / hydrate_* are the S3 and Firecracker costs).

display.name: Wakes per second by mode
display.description: Mix of wake outcomes. assigned = cold boot; assign_timeout = the host took longer than 30s.

display.name: Cold boots by stale reason
display.description: Why a host refused to resume a snapshot it had (metal_stale_snapshot_skipped_by_reason_total). Per host; replicas report the same host, so max not sum.

display.name: Resume outcomes per host
display.description: Local hits, store hits, cold misses, and drift repaired in place instead of a cold boot.

display.name: Region utilization (idle tier switch at 60%)
display.description: assigned ÷ (live hosts × MAX_VMS_PER_HOST). At 60% hosts move to the aggressive idle window, and back below 55%.

display.name: Idle tier per host (1 = aggressive)
display.description: reason: directive (region policy), host_guard (host near its VM cap), stale (no fresh directive, failing safe), static (standalone).

display.name: Idle suspends by tier, and deferred by the per-pass cap
display.description: metal_idle_suspended_by_tier_total and metal_idle_reap_deferred_total (VMs past their window left for the next pass).

display.name: Periodic source backups (long-resident VMs)
display.description: Mid-residency source backups. Failures mean edits since placement are only on the VM.
